messages:
maya: Quick preflight — we need a short URL health sweep + canonical/redirect plan for the webinar landing and the accompanying benchmark blog before Thursday. Also want a minimal JSON-LD event schema and internal-linking anchor plan so inbound routing doesn't drop leads. Anyone able to triage?

luke: I can pick up the redirect map and sitemap patch. Where should I push the list? GDoc or PR?

maya: GDoc for initial pass: https://docs.google.com/drive/fake-webinar-preflight (please add edits). Then we convert to a small PR for infra to apply redirects.

raj: Priority checklist: 1) canonical tag + rel=canonical audit across mirrored blog pages 2) JSON-LD event schema (date/time, registrationURL) 3) ensure OG/Twitter meta for share cards 4) sitemap prioritization and lastmod 5) redirect sweep for previous webinars (301 recommended for old event pages) 

raj: quick example JSON-LD we should use (add exact timestamp/placeholders):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Benchmarking LLM Inference","startDate":"2026-04-08T16:00:00-07:00","endDate":"2026-04-08T17:00:00-07:00","eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.com/webinar/benchmarks"},"offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://redwood.com/webinar/benchmarks/register","price":"0","availability":"https://schema.org/InStock"}}
```

seo-bot: quick scan attached — found 6 duplicate-ish URLs that need canonicalization, 2 missing OG titles, 3 redirect candidates, and sitemap not including /webinar/benchmarks yet. Full report in the GDoc under 'automated-scan'.

alexa: For inbound routing — marketing wants UTMs that map to HubSpot source + campaign. Proposal: utm_source=webinar, utm_campaign=bench-bench-2026, utm_medium=email|social. Need a note that CRM mapping must route to a lead-stage 'webinar_reg' and set a list membership for follow-up sequences.

luke: Redirect format I'll push to the doc: one-line CSV with from,to,code,reason. Example: `/old/bench-2023,/webinar/benchmarks,301,consolidate older benchmark page`. We'll also mark any permanently removed pages as 410.

maya: Internal linking plan: put 3 contextual links from product docs + 2 links from blog hub pages. Use short, descriptive anchors ("LLM inference benchmarks", not "click here"). Prioritize anchors in breadcrumbs and hub page CTAs.

raj: SEO note — avoid canonicalizing the registration query string; canonical should point to the main landing without session params. Also add a small snippet to block crawlers on /thank-you pages (noindex) so gated content doesn't pollute index.

alexa: On routing, once the reg form fires, we need the redirect to include a `?hs_redirect=webinar-bench-2026` so analytics can pick it up and the webhook can identify source via Referer + UTM. Is that OK?

luke: yes. I'll include that parameter in the redirect plan and the PR.

maya: Tasks: luke = redirect CSV + sitemap patch (due EOD Wed), raj = JSON-LD final copy + canonical audit (due Tue morning), alexa = CRM/UTM mapping doc + webhook spec (due Tue), i'll coordinate PR + tracking QA.

maya: If no blockers, i'll create the PR template and tag @eng-frontend for 301s. :thumbsup:

seo-bot: small follow-up — add `<link rel=\"canonical\" href=\"https://redwood.com/webinar/benchmarks\" />` to head on all variants. Also check server-side redirects preserve UTM.

luke: noted. Adding a small test script snippet for infra: `curl -I "https://redwood.com/old/bench-2023?utm_source=test"` -> should show `Location: https://redwood.com/webinar/benchmarks?utm_source=test&hs_redirect=webinar-bench-2026` and `HTTP/1.1 301`.

maya: Great — thats enough to start. I'll allocate time in the GDoc for manual QA slots. Ping here with quick updates. :sparkles:
